_comment: Objective types: collectItem, repairModule, talkTo, discoverLandmark, findCrewLog, findAnyCrewLogs, craftItem, harvestCrop, reachRelationship.

quests.title: Someone Is Still Here
quests.summary: The colony was listed as abandoned. It is not. Find whoever is out on the terrace.

objectives.description: Find the person working the south terrace

quests.completionText: Sefa hands over a fistful of seed and goes back to work.

quests.title: Breaking Ground
quests.summary: Prove the terrace still grows something. Till a bed, plant, water it, and bring in a harvest.
quests._comment: No prerequisite on purpose: the player can start farming before they meet anyone, and an act-based objective only counts while its quest is running.
quests.completionText: Three days from seed to light. The terrace still works.

quests.title: First Breath
quests.summary: The oxygen recycler is offline. Salvage what it needs and bring it back up.
quests.completionText: The station exhales for the first time in four years.

quests.title: Signal Discipline
quests.summary: The long-range dish never sent anything. Rebuild it and find out why.
quests.completionText: The outbound queue comes up empty. Four years, and nobody called for help.

quests.title: The Green Room
quests.summary: Sefa wants the terrace irrigation running before the dry season.
quests.completionText: The controller wakes up mid-programme, as if it had only been paused.

quests.title: What Happened Here
quests.summary: Eleven people walked out of a working colony. Find every log they left and go where they went.
quests.completionText: You have the whole record now. Open the journal.

quests.title: Seedstock
quests.summary: Sefa's glassroot strain keeps failing. She wants three clean tubers to start again.
quests.completionText: Sefa turns a tuber over twice and stops talking for a while.

quests.title: Parts Ledger
quests.summary: Rike keeps a ledger of everything the old crew removed. He is short on stock to compare against.
quests.completionText: Rike closes the ledger. 'Nothing here was broken. It was undone.'

quests.title: Sleep Study
quests.summary: Nnenna is collecting dream reports and does not want to explain why yet.
quests.completionText: Nnenna reads Renn's log twice and says, very evenly, that she has had that dream.
